name: Sunscreen
description: An overprotective, warm-hearted dad in his forties who sings sunny sixties-style close-harmony surf pop, always ready with the sunscreen.
build: A soft, average dad build: medium rounded shoulders, a modest paunch, arms and legs of ordinary length, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Very pale fair skin, a broad bold stripe of thick white zinc cream down the nose, round brown eyes under straight brown brows, a friendly round nose, a neat brown moustache, and thin lips.
hair: Short neat brown hair, side-parted, showing below the hat.
outfit: A very wide-brimmed khaki-tan bucket-style sun hat with a chin cord; a loose short-sleeved mustard-yellow shirt with big bold white palm-tree prints, buttoned up; knee-length navy cargo shorts; white crew socks pulled high; brown leather sandals. A small tan waist pack at the belly. Both hands bare.
performance_style: Earnest and upright: feet hip-width, weight even. Both arms slightly forward, the character-right and character-left hands open and empty at waist height, palms up as if offering help. Head level, a kind eager smile.
location: A family spot on a crowded sunny beach: pale sand running to the bottom of the frame, a big striped beach umbrella planted behind, a cool box and a folding chair, a sandcastle with a little flag, and a bright blue sea and sky beyond.
recognition_cues: a broad white zinc stripe down the nose
a very wide-brimmed khaki sun hat with a chin cord
a mustard shirt with big white palm prints
white socks pulled high with sandals
avoid: a sunscreen bottle on the key art

sing.intent: Close-harmony surf-pop vocal loop: a bouncy step-touch side to side, raise the mic in the character-right hand to the mouth, wag the open character-left hand in a friendly finger-raised warning at chest height, then return to the earnest stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief startle at a beach ball: the shoulders jump, both open hands fly up protectively at chest height, then he settles back to the earnest stance. No opponent, strike or physical contact.
animations.guard: One-shot self-protection: step wide, spread both open arms out at chest height as if shielding the family, then hold a steady finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: hurry in with quick short steps, turn square to the front, and settle into the earnest stance with both hands open.
animations.victory: One-shot celebration: plant both sandals, raise both open hands high in a big two-handed wave, tip the head back into a proud open-mouthed laugh, then hold the pose.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: the dad-energy fizzles — the shoulders slump, both open hands hang at his sides, and his head droops so the hat brim tips down, holding a deflated standing finish. He remains standing on both planted feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking, or going to the ground. Do not imply impact, injury, or an opponent.
